Finding: Company date format is ignored in opening evidence and history
Trigger: Configure dd/MM/yyyy and inspect document dates or retained opening history
Observed: Document dates display as ISO dates; captured and finalized timestamps are displayed without the configured formatter
Expected: Use shared company date and datetime formatters while preserving unknown or restricted values
Impact: Inconsistent and harder to read financial evidence
Recommendation: Apply shared date formatters to evidence revisions and history
Verification: 137 opening UI tests and 2 reusable acceptance checks passed; configured dates timezone conversion and restricted finalization covered

Finding: Failed posting-link lookup is labelled Draft not prepared
Trigger: Open an entry in a finalized workspace while posting-link returns 503
Observed: Posting journal shows Draft not prepared alongside the lookup error
Expected: A failed or pending lookup should show unknown or unavailable; unprepared should require a successful NOT_PREPARED response
Impact: Users can mistake a posted opening for an unprepared draft
Recommendation: Render distinct loading unavailable unprepared and posted states with retry
Verification: Pending unavailable exact NOT_PREPARED native states 401/403/422/503 and successful read retry covered; 137 opening UI tests passed

Finding: Contracted owner commit order is absent
Trigger: Two journals have the same business posting date and draft creation order differs from commit order
Observed: Ledger uses posting_date journal_id line_sequence line_id; it has no native owner commit sequence
Expected: Preserve native owner commit order in the source contract projection and pinned ledger cursor
Impact: Same-day intermediate balances and statement order can differ from the specified commit order; closing sums are unaffected
Recommendation: Design native commit sequence and historical compatibility; version exports projections indexes and report runtimes
Verification: Contract and implementation inspection; existing deterministic pagination tests pass

Finding: Ledger particulars and source explanation are incomplete
Trigger: Inspect ledger rows or their row details for a narrated journal
Observed: Numbers kinds amounts and some voucher lineage exist; journal and line descriptions and human source reference are absent from ledger output
Expected: Expose authorized narration and source explanation with a clear owner handoff and counterpart detail where permitted
Impact: Reviewers need extra navigation to explain a movement
Recommendation: Carry protected source particulars into a versioned report row and use existing drilldown; do not invent missing producer evidence
Verification: Code and report definition inspection; existing voucher drilldown is present

Finding: Filtered ledger does not explain full balance-at-row
Trigger: Filter an account ledger to a later journal with omitted earlier movements
Observed: Running balances remain correct for the full account ledger but are labelled Balance with no explicit scope or separate filtered totals
Expected: Label full-ledger balance-at-row and provide filtered movement totals or omit running balances for a movement-only view
Impact: Visible rows cannot alone reconcile the displayed balance and users may interpret it as a filtered balance
Recommendation: Make balance scope explicit in the report definition UI and export; keep correct full-ledger arithmetic
Verification: Reference and production native-query reproductions passed in disposable fixtures

Finding: Ledger view lacks a pinned period turnover and closing summary
Trigger: Run an account ledger for a bounded period including a zero-movement account
Observed: Ledger emits opening and entry rows with running balances; no integrated period gross debit gross credit and explicit closing summary
Expected: A summary for the same authorized snapshot should reconcile opening plus gross debits minus gross credits to closing
Impact: Users must switch reports or manually total pages to check period turnover
Recommendation: Reuse existing account daily or period summaries for the pinned full result; never total only the visible page
Verification: Code inspection; separate daily and period summary reports already exist and their tests pass
